summary.headline: Dating Julian of Laodicea
summary.text: Argument that Julian of Laodicea flourished in the fourth century around 379, based on citations by Paulus Alexandrinus, Palchus, Theophilus of Edessa, and a ninth-century Byzantine fragment. Compares Julian’s fixed-star positions with Ptolemy’s Syntaxis and begins a table showing a 3°36′ longitude difference for a star in Scorpio.
